attach_model_to_data_sparsifier: attach a PyTorch model to a data sparsifier by looping over weight parameters and registering supported types
get_valid_name: convert a PyTorch layer name with dots to an underscore-separated name valid for the data sparsifier
log_sparsified_level: log the sparsity level of each supported layer parameter in a PyTorch model using the data sparsifier masks
